definitions.budget-exhausted: Existing budget-withholding code retained without renaming.
definitions.diff-too-large: The requested diff exceeds the permitted execution scope.
definitions.runner-crashed: The runner failed before completing the requested work.
definitions.bad_request: The materializer request or required configuration is invalid.
definitions.not_found: The requested subject could not be found.
definitions.snapshot_unavailable: A required feed has no usable snapshot.
definitions.source_unavailable: A source refresh failed while retained data remains usable.
definitions.ledger_unconfigured: A ledger audit was requested without a configured ledger.
